exposure: Singleton pregnancies in women without endometriosis or endometrial polyps
Singleton pregnancies in women with endometriosis and endometrial polyps
cohort: 1263 infertile patients, including 451 with endometriosis (204 with endometrial polyps and 247 without)
finding: Women with endometriosis have a higher frequency of endometrial polyps, and those with both conditions have an increased risk of placenta previa and cesarean delivery during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with both endometriosis and endometrial polyps have an independently elevated risk of cesarean delivery during pregnancy.
